A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

(d) Using a screwdriver, remove the 2 oil seals.

AT5106

25. REMOVE OIL PUMP
(a) Stand up the transmission.
(b) Remove the 7 bolts holding the oil pump to the transmission case.

AT5122

(c) Using SST, remove the oil pump.
SST 09610-20012
(d) Remove the O-ring from it.

SST

AT5123

(e) Remove the race from the oil pump.

AT8431

26. REMOVE OVERDRIVE PLANETARY GEAR WITH OVERDRIVE DIRECT CLUTCH AND ONE-WAY CLUTCH
(a) Remove the overdrive planetary gear with the overdrive direct clutch and overdrive one-way clutch from the transmission case.

Q00619
